name: GRouNdGAN causal-controller checkpoint
description: PyTorch checkpoint for the pretrained causal-controller GAN used internally by GRouNdGAN before the causal model is instantiated.
validation_notes: The file must be loadable by torch.load in the GRouNdGAN runtime.
The checkpoint must contain the generator_state_dict entry expected by GRouNdGAN's CausalGAN constructor.
The checkpoint must match the CC Model architecture, number of genes and library-size settings used by the final model checkpoint.
